accepted.quote: We oppose H.R. 6373, the ``Air Permitting Improvements to Protect National Security Act of 2025,'' which allows the President to exempt certain polluting facilities from Clean Air Act (CAA) requirements, under the undefined guise of a ``national security interest.''
accepted.bill: H.R. 6373, the ``Air Permitting Improvements to Protect National Security Act of 2025,''
accepted.rationale: Opposition to Clean Air Act exemptions indicates support for maintaining strong environmental regulation.
